```cpp
#include "hwid.hpp"
#include "sdk/sdk.hpp"
#include <ntddstor.h>
#include <intrin.h>

NTSTATUS get_smbios_uuid(UCHAR out_uuid[16]) {
    ULONG size = sizeof(SYSTEM_FIRMWARE_TABLE_INFORMATION);
    PSYSTEM_FIRMWARE_TABLE_INFORMATION info =
        (PSYSTEM_FIRMWARE_TABLE_INFORMATION)ExAllocatePool2(POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED, size, 'SMBI');
    if (!info) return STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES;

    info->ProviderSignature = 'RSMB';
    info->Action = SystemFirmwareTable_Get;
    info->TableID = 0;
    info->TableBufferLength = 0;

    ULONG return_length = 0;
    NTSTATUS status = ZwQuerySystemInformation(SystemFirmwareTableInformation, info, size, &return_length);

    ExFreePoolWithTag(info, 'SMBI');
    size = return_length;
    info = (PSYSTEM_FIRMWARE_TABLE_INFORMATION)ExAllocatePool2(POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED, size, 'SMBI');
    if (!info) return STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES;

    info->ProviderSignature = 'RSMB';
    info->Action = SystemFirmwareTable_Get;
    info->TableID = 0;
    info->TableBufferLength = size;

    status = ZwQuerySystemInformation(SystemFirmwareTableInformation, info, size, &return_length);

    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        ExFreePoolWithTag(info, 'SMBI');
        return status;
    }

    PUCHAR smbios = info->TableBuffer + 8;
    PUCHAR ptr = smbios;
    PUCHAR end = smbios + (info->TableBufferLength - 8);

    while (ptr + 4 <= end) {
        UCHAR type = ptr[0];
        UCHAR length = ptr[1];

        if (type == 127 || length < 4)
            break;

        if (type == 1 && length >= 0x19 && (ptr + 8 + 16 <= end)) {
            RtlCopyMemory(out_uuid, ptr + 8, 16);
            ExFreePoolWithTag(info, 'SMBI');
            return STATUS_SUCCESS;
        }

        PUCHAR str_section = ptr + length;
        while (str_section + 1 < end && !(str_section[0] == 0 && str_section[1] == 0))
            str_section++;
        ptr = str_section + 2;
    }

    ExFreePoolWithTag(info, 'SMBI');
    return STATUS_NOT_FOUND;
}

ULONG get_cpu_hash() {
    int cpu_info[4] = { 0 };

    __cpuid(cpu_info, 0);
    ULONG hash = (ULONG)cpu_info[0] ^ (ULONG)cpu_info[1] ^ (ULONG)cpu_info[2] ^ (ULONG)cpu_info[3];

    __cpuid(cpu_info, 1);
    hash ^= (ULONG)cpu_info[0];
    hash ^= (ULONG)cpu_info[3];

    __cpuidex(cpu_info, 4, 0);
    hash ^= (ULONG)cpu_info[0];

    return hash;
}

NTSTATUS get_disk_serial(ULONG* out_serial) {
    UNICODE_STRING disk_path = RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"\\Device\\Harddisk0\\DR0");

    OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES oa;
    InitializeObjectAttributes(&oa, &disk_path, OBJ_KERNEL_HANDLE | OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE, NULL, NULL);

    IO_STATUS_BLOCK iosb;
    HANDLE h_disk;
    NTSTATUS status = ZwOpenFile(&h_disk, GENERIC_READ | SYNCHRONIZE, &oa, &iosb,
        FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE, FILE_SYNCHRONOUS_IO_NONALERT);

    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) return status;

    ULONG buf_size = sizeof(STORAGE_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR) + 256;
    PSTORAGE_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR desc = (PSTORAGE_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR)
        ExAllocatePool2(POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED, buf_size, 'DISK');
    if (!desc) { ZwClose(h_disk); return STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES; }

    STORAGE_PROPERTY_QUERY query;
    RtlZeroMemory(&query, sizeof(query));
    query.PropertyId = StorageDeviceProperty;
    query.QueryType = PropertyStandardQuery;

    status = ZwDeviceIoControlFile(h_disk, NULL, NULL, NULL, &iosb,
        IOCTL_STORAGE_QUERY_PROPERTY, &query, sizeof(query), desc, buf_size);

    if (NT_SUCCESS(status) && desc->SerialNumberOffset != 0) {
        PCHAR serial = (PCHAR)desc + desc->SerialNumberOffset;
        ULONG hash = 0;
        for (ULONG i = 0; serial[i] != 0; i++)
            hash = hash * 31 + (UCHAR)serial[i];
        *out_serial = hash;
    }

    ExFreePoolWithTag(desc, 'DISK');
    ZwClose(h_disk);
    return status;
}

HWID build_hwid() {
    HWID hwid;
    RtlZeroMemory(&hwid, sizeof(hwid));

    hwid.cpu_hash = get_cpu_hash();

    UCHAR uuid[16];
    if (NT_SUCCESS(get_smbios_uuid(uuid)))
        RtlCopyMemory(hwid.smbios_uuid, uuid, 16);

    hwid.disk_serial = NT_SUCCESS(get_disk_serial(&hwid.disk_serial)) ? hwid.disk_serial : 0;

    return hwid;
}
```

`driver/core/scheduler/scheduler.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "scheduler.hpp"
#include "core/detection/integrity/hash_sections/hash_sections.hpp"
#include "core/detection/manual_mapped_drivers/big_pool_track/big_pool_track.hpp"
#include "core/detection/manual_mapped_drivers/kernel_space_walking/kernel_space_walking.hpp"
#include "core/global.hpp"
#include <ntdef.h>
#include <ntifs.h>
#include <wdm.h>
#include "core/reporting/report_hash_diff/report_hash_diff.hpp"
#include "sdk/crypto/hashes.hpp"
#include "sdk/pe/pe.hpp"
#include "../detection/byovd/byovd_scan.hpp"
#include "tasks.hpp"
#include <intrin.h>

ULONG random_in_range(ULONG min, ULONG max) {
    ULONG r = RtlRandomEx(&g_ringo_context.scheduler.random_seed);
    return min + (r % (max - min + 1));
}

VOID scheduler(PVOID context) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(context);
    g_ringo_context.scheduler.random_seed = (ULONG)KeQueryInterruptTime() ^ (ULONG)__rdtsc();

    // one-time-tasks
    detect_byovd_drivers_at_runtime();

    while (!g_ringo_context.scheduler.scheduler_stop) {
        LARGE_INTEGER timeout;
        timeout.QuadPart = -(LONGLONG)random_in_range(8000, 12000) * 10000;
        KeWaitForSingleObject(&g_stop_event, Executive, KernelMode, FALSE, &timeout);
        if (g_ringo_context.scheduler.scheduler_stop) break;

        switch (random_in_range(0, 2)) {
            case 0: hash_compare(); break;
            case 1: thread_walking();                break;
            case 2: big_pool_detect();               break;
        }
    }

    PsTerminateSystemThread(STATUS_SUCCESS);
}
```

`driver/core/scheduler/tasks.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "scheduler.hpp"
#include "core/detection/integrity/hash_sections/hash_sections.hpp"
#include "core/detection/manual_mapped_drivers/big_pool_track/big_pool_track.hpp"
#include "core/detection/manual_mapped_drivers/kernel_space_walking/kernel_space_walking.hpp"
#include "core/global.hpp"
#include <ntdef.h>
#include <ntifs.h>
#include <wdm.h>
#include "core/reporting/report_hash_diff/report_hash_diff.hpp"
#include "sdk/crypto/hashes.hpp"
#include "sdk/pe/pe.hpp"
#include "../detection/byovd/byovd_scan.hpp"
#include "tasks.hpp"

void hash_compare() {
    UCHAR process_image2[HASH_SIZE_SHA256];
    UCHAR disk_image[HASH_SIZE_SHA256];

    if (!g_ringo_context.game.is_game_open) return;

    if (!hash_disk_game_image(disk_image) || !hash_process_image(process_image2))
        return;

    if (!g_ringo_context.game.first_hash_catched) {
        RtlCopyMemory(g_ringo_context.game.last_image_hash, process_image2, HASH_SIZE_SHA256);
        g_ringo_context.game.first_hash_catched = TRUE;
    }

    if (!compare_hash(process_image2, g_ringo_context.game.last_image_hash))
        report_hash_mismatch(PROCESS_WITH_PROCESS);

    if (!compare_hash(process_image2, disk_image))
        report_hash_mismatch(FILE_WITH_PROCESS);

    RtlCopyMemory(g_ringo_context.game.last_image_hash, process_image2, HASH_SIZE_SHA256);
}
```

```cpp
BOOLEAN zw_check(BOOLEAN* p_hvci_enabled) {

	sci.Length = sizeof(sci);
	
	ULONG return_length = 0;
	NTSTATUS status = ZwQuerySystemInformation(SystemCodeIntegrityInformation, &sci, sizeof(sci), &return_length);

	if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
		return FALSE;

		BOOLEAN hvci_enabled = (sci.CodeIntegrityOptions & CODEINTEGRITY_OPTION_HVCI_KMCI_ENABLED) != 0;

	}

		hc.code_integrity.valid = TRUE;
		hc.code_integrity.value = hvci_enabled;
	}

	return hc;
```

```cpp
BOOLEAN zw_system_hypervisor_information_check(BOOLEAN* p_is_hypervisor_present) {
	ULONG return_length = 0;

	SYSTEM_HYPERVISOR_INFORMATION shi = { 0 };
	NTSTATUS status = ZwQuerySystemInformation(SystemHypervisorInformation, &shi, sizeof(shi), &return_length);

	if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) return false;
	else {
		*p_is_hypervisor_present = shi.HypervisorPresent;
		return TRUE;
	}
}

HYPERVISOR_CHECK get_hypervisor_info() {
	HYPERVISOR_CHECK hc = {};

	BOOLEAN hypervisor_present;
	if (zw_system_hypervisor_information_check(&hypervisor_present)) {
		hc.nt_query.valid = TRUE;
		hc.nt_query.value = hypervisor_present;
	}

	int cpu_info[4];
	__cpuid(cpu_info, 1);
	hc.cpuid.valid = TRUE;
	hc.cpuid.value = (cpu_info[2] >> 31) & 1;

	return hc;
}
```

`driver/core/system/secure_boot/secure_boot.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <initguid.h> 
#include "secure_boot.hpp"
#include "sdk/sdk.hpp"

DEFINE_GUID(EFI_GLOBAL_VARIABLE_GUID,
	0x8be4df61, 0x93ca, 0x11d2, 0xaa, 0x0d, 0x00, 0xe0, 0x98, 0x03, 0x2b, 0x8c);

BOOLEAN zw_query_check(_SYSTEM_SECUREBOOT_INFORMATION* psbi) {
	_SYSTEM_SECUREBOOT_INFORMATION sbi = { 0 };
	ULONG return_length = 0;

	NTSTATUS status = ZwQuerySystemInformation(SystemSecureBootInformation, &sbi, sizeof(sbi), &return_length);

	if (!NT_SUCCESS(status))
		return FALSE; // not supported

	else {
		*psbi = sbi;
		return TRUE;
	}
}

BOOLEAN uefi_check(BOOLEAN* p_enabled) {
	UNICODE_STRING var_name;
	RtlInitUnicodeString(&var_name, L"SecureBoot");

	UCHAR value = 0;
	ULONG value_length = sizeof(value);
	ULONG attributes = 0;

	NTSTATUS status = ExGetFirmwareEnvironmentVariable(&var_name, (LPGUID)&EFI_GLOBAL_VARIABLE_GUID, &value, &value_length, &attributes);

	if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
		return FALSE; // no uefi or not existing variable, or legacy bios
	}
	else {
		*p_enabled = (value != 0);
		return TRUE;
	}
}

BOOLEAN registry_key_check(BOOLEAN* p_enabled)
{
	*p_enabled = FALSE;

	UNICODE_STRING key_path;
	RtlInitUnicodeString(&key_path, L"\\Registry\\Machine\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\SecureBoot\\State");

	OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES obj_attr;
	InitializeObjectAttributes(&obj_attr, &key_path, OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE | OBJ_KERNEL_HANDLE, NULL, NULL);

	HANDLE handle;
	NTSTATUS status = ZwOpenKey(&handle, KEY_READ, &obj_attr);
	if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
		return FALSE;
	}

	UNICODE_STRING value_name;
	RtlInitUnicodeString(&value_name, L"UEFISecureBootEnabled");

	UCHAR buffer[sizeof(KEY_VALUE_PARTIAL_INFORMATION) + sizeof(ULONG)];
	PKEY_VALUE_PARTIAL_INFORMATION p_info = (PKEY_VALUE_PARTIAL_INFORMATION)buffer;
	ULONG result_length = 0;

	status = ZwQueryValueKey(handle, &value_name, KeyValuePartialInformation, buffer, sizeof(buffer), &result_length);
	ZwClose(handle);

	if (NT_SUCCESS(status) && p_info->Type == REG_DWORD && p_info->DataLength == sizeof(ULONG)) {
		ULONG value = *(PULONG)p_info->Data;
		*p_enabled = (value != 0);
		return TRUE;
	}

	return FALSE;
}

SECURE_BOOT_CHECK is_secure_boot_enabled() {
	SECURE_BOOT_CHECK sbc = {};

	_SYSTEM_SECUREBOOT_INFORMATION sbi = { 0 };
	if (zw_query_check(&sbi)) {
		sbc.nt_query_enabled.valid = TRUE;
		sbc.nt_query_enabled.value = sbi.SecureBootEnabled;
		sbc.nt_query_capable.valid = TRUE;
		sbc.nt_query_capable.value = sbi.SecureBootCapable;
	}

	BOOLEAN uefi_check_enabled;
	if (uefi_check(&uefi_check_enabled)) {
		sbc.uefi_var.valid = TRUE;
		sbc.uefi_var.value = uefi_check_enabled;
	}

	BOOLEAN reg_check_enabled;
	if (registry_key_check(&reg_check_enabled)) {
		sbc.registry.valid = TRUE;
		sbc.registry.value = reg_check_enabled;
	}

	return sbc;
}
```

```cpp
BOOLEAN check_test_signing(BOOLEAN* p_test_signing_enabled) {
	*p_test_signing_enabled = FALSE;

	SYSTEM_CODEINTEGRITY_INFORMATION sci = { 0 };
	sci.Length = sizeof(sci);

	ULONG return_length = 0;
	NTSTATUS status = ZwQuerySystemInformation(SystemCodeIntegrityInformation, &sci, sizeof(sci), &return_length);

	if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
		return FALSE;
	}

	*p_test_signing_enabled = (sci.CodeIntegrityOptions & CODEINTEGRITY_OPTION_TESTSIGN) != 0;
	return TRUE;
}

TEST_SIGNING_CHECK is_test_signing_enabled() {
	TEST_SIGNING_CHECK tsc = {};

	BOOLEAN test_signing_enabled;
	if (check_test_signing(&test_signing_enabled)) {
		tsc.code_integrity.valid = TRUE;
		tsc.code_integrity.value = test_signing_enabled;
	}

	return tsc;
}
```

`driver/core/system/tpm/tpm.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "sdk/sdk.hpp"
#include "tpm.hpp"

static NTSTATUS open_tpm_device(HANDLE* out_handle) {
    UNICODE_STRING device_name = RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"\\Device\\TPM");
    OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES obj_attr;
    IO_STATUS_BLOCK io_status;

    InitializeObjectAttributes(&obj_attr, &device_name, OBJ_KERNEL_HANDLE | OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE, NULL, NULL);

    return ZwCreateFile(
        out_handle,
        GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE,
        &obj_attr,
        &io_status,
        NULL,
        FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,
        0,
        FILE_OPEN,
        FILE_SYNCHRONOUS_IO_NONALERT,
        NULL,
        0
    );
}

static NTSTATUS send_tpm_command(HANDLE h_tpm, UCHAR* command, ULONG command_size, UCHAR* response, ULONG* response_size) {
    IO_STATUS_BLOCK io_status;

    NTSTATUS status = ZwWriteFile(
        h_tpm,
        NULL, NULL, NULL,
        &io_status,
        command,
        command_size,
        NULL, NULL
    );

    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        return status;
    }

    RtlZeroMemory(&io_status, sizeof(io_status));

    status = ZwReadFile(
        h_tpm,
        NULL, NULL, NULL,
        &io_status,
        response,
        *response_size,
        NULL, NULL
    );

    if (NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        *response_size = (ULONG)io_status.Information;
    }

    return status;
}

TPM_CHECK get_tpm_version() {
    TPM_CHECK tpm = {};

    HANDLE h_tpm = NULL;
    NTSTATUS status = open_tpm_device(&h_tpm);

    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        KdPrint(("[-] Failed to open TPM device: 0x%X\n", status));
        return tpm;
    }

    // try TPM 2.0 first — TPM2_GetRandom command
    UCHAR tpm2_command[] = {
        0x80, 0x01,
        0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0C,
        0x00, 0x00, 0x01, 0x7B,
        0x00, 0x20
    };

    UCHAR tpm_response[128] = { 0 };
    ULONG response_length = sizeof(tpm_response);

    status = send_tpm_command(h_tpm, tpm2_command, sizeof(tpm2_command), tpm_response, &response_length);

    if (NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        if (response_length < 10) {
            KdPrint(("[-] TPM 2.0 response too short (%lu bytes).\n", response_length));
        }
        else {
            UINT32 return_code = (tpm_response[6] << 24) | (tpm_response[7] << 16) |
                (tpm_response[8] << 8) | tpm_response[9];

            tpm.tpm_2_0.valid = TRUE;
            tpm.tpm_2_0.value = return_code == 0;
            if (tpm.tpm_2_0.value) {
                KdPrint(("[+] TPM 2.0 detected and responsive.\n"));
                ZwClose(h_tpm);
                return tpm;
            }
        }
    }

    // fallback: TPM 1.2 — TPM_ORD_GetRandom command
    RtlZeroMemory(tpm_response, sizeof(tpm_response));
    response_length = sizeof(tpm_response);

    UCHAR tpm1_command[] = {
        0x00, 0xC1,
        0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x0E,
        0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x46,
        0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x20
    };

    status = send_tpm_command(h_tpm, tpm1_command, sizeof(tpm1_command), tpm_response, &response_length);

    if (NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        if (response_length < 10) {
            KdPrint(("[-] TPM 1.2 response too short (%lu bytes).\n", response_length));
        }
        else {
            UINT32 return_code = (tpm_response[6] << 24) | (tpm_response[7] << 16) |
                (tpm_response[8] << 8) | tpm_response[9];

            tpm.tpm_1_2.valid = TRUE;
            tpm.tpm_1_2.value = return_code == 0;
            if (tpm.tpm_1_2.value)
                KdPrint(("[+] TPM 1.2 detected and responsive.\n"));
        }
    }

    KdPrint(("[-] No functional TPM found.\n"));
    ZwClose(h_tpm);
    return tpm;
}
```

```cpp
#include "vbs.hpp"

BOOLEAN zw_check(BOOLEAN* p_is_vbs_enabled, BOOLEAN* p_is_hvci_enabled) {
	ULONG return_length = 0;

	SYSTEM_ISOLATED_USER_MODE_INFORMATION siumi = { 0 };
	NTSTATUS status = ZwQuerySystemInformation(SystemIsolatedUserModeInformation, &siumi, sizeof(siumi), &return_length);

	if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) return FALSE;
	else {
		*p_is_hvci_enabled = siumi.HvciEnabled;
		*p_is_vbs_enabled = siumi.SecureKernelRunning;

		return TRUE;
	}
}

VBS_CHECK is_vbs_enabled() {
	VBS_CHECK vc = {};
	BOOLEAN is_vbs_enabled, is_hvci_enabled;

	if (zw_check(&is_vbs_enabled, &is_hvci_enabled)) {
		vc.nt_query_secure_kernel.valid = TRUE;
		vc.nt_query_secure_kernel.value = is_vbs_enabled;
		vc.nt_query_hvci.valid = TRUE;
		vc.nt_query_hvci.value = is_hvci_enabled;
	}

	return vc;
}
```

`driver/main.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/callbacks/ob_callback/ob_callback.hpp"
#include "core/callbacks/image_notify/image_notify.hpp"
#include "core/callbacks/create_thread_notify/create_thread_notify.hpp"
#include "core/callbacks/create_process_notify/create_process_notify.hpp"
#include "core/global.hpp"
#include "core/communication/communication.hpp"
#include "core/scheduler/scheduler.hpp"
#include <wdm.h>

void driver_unload(PDRIVER_OBJECT DriverObject) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(DriverObject);

    // stop the scheduler thread and wait for it to finish before tearing anything else down
    InterlockedExchange(&g_ringo_context.scheduler.scheduler_stop, TRUE);
    KeSetEvent(&g_stop_event, IO_NO_INCREMENT, FALSE);

    if (g_ringo_context.scheduler.scheduler_thread_handle != NULL) {
        PVOID thread_object = NULL;

        if (NT_SUCCESS(ObReferenceObjectByHandle(
                g_ringo_context.scheduler.scheduler_thread_handle,
                THREAD_ALL_ACCESS, *PsThreadType, KernelMode, &thread_object, NULL))) {
            KeWaitForSingleObject(thread_object, Executive, KernelMode, FALSE, NULL);
            ObDereferenceObject(thread_object);
        }

        ZwClose(g_ringo_context.scheduler.scheduler_thread_handle);
        g_ringo_context.scheduler.scheduler_thread_handle = NULL;
    }

    if (g_ringo_context.callbacks.ob.callback_handle != NULL)
        ObUnRegisterCallbacks(g_ringo_context.callbacks.ob.callback_handle);

    if (g_ringo_context.callbacks.load_image.is_registered == TRUE)
        PsRemoveLoadImageNotifyRoutine(g_ringo_context.callbacks.load_image.callback_ptr);

    if (g_ringo_context.callbacks.create_thread.is_registered == TRUE)
        PsRemoveCreateThreadNotifyRoutine(g_ringo_context.callbacks.create_thread.callback_ptr);

    if (g_ringo_context.callbacks.create_process.is_registered == TRUE)
        PsSetCreateProcessNotifyRoutineEx(g_ringo_context.callbacks.create_process.callback_ptr, TRUE);

    cleanup_device();

    KdPrint(("Ringo Driver Unloaded\n"));
}

extern "C"
NTSTATUS DriverEntry(PDRIVER_OBJECT DriverObject, PUNICODE_STRING RegistryPath) {
    UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER(RegistryPath);
    KdPrint(("Ringo Driver Loaded\n"));

    InterlockedExchange(&g_ringo_context.scheduler.scheduler_stop, FALSE);
    
    // load callbacks
    g_ringo_context.callbacks.ob.callback_handle = ob_register_callbacks_open_process();
    if (g_ringo_context.callbacks.ob.callback_handle == NULL) {
        KdPrint(("[-] ob_callback_handle not loaded.\n"));
    }

    set_load_image_callback();
    if (g_ringo_context.callbacks.load_image.is_registered == FALSE) {
        KdPrint(("[-] SetLoadImage Callback not loaded.\n"));
    }

    set_create_thread_callback();
    if (g_ringo_context.callbacks.create_thread.is_registered == FALSE) {
        KdPrint(("[-] create_thread_callback not loaded.\n"));
    }

    set_create_process_callback();
    if (g_ringo_context.callbacks.create_process.is_registered == FALSE) {
        KdPrint(("[-] CreateProcessCallback not loaded.\n"));
    }

    if (!NT_SUCCESS(setup_device(DriverObject))) {
        KdPrint(("[-] IOCTL setup not loaded\n"));
    }

    KeInitializeEvent(&g_stop_event, NotificationEvent, FALSE);
    
    NTSTATUS thread_status = PsCreateSystemThread(
        &g_ringo_context.scheduler.scheduler_thread_handle,
        THREAD_ALL_ACCESS, 
        NULL, 
        NULL, 
        NULL, 
        scheduler, 
        NULL
    );

    if (!NT_SUCCESS(thread_status)) {
        g_ringo_context.scheduler.scheduler_thread_handle = NULL;
        KdPrint(("[-] scheduler thread not created\n"));
    }
    
    DriverObject->DriverUnload = driver_unload;

    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}
```

`driver/sdk/crypto/hashes.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "../sdk.hpp"
#include <ntimage.h>
#include <bcrypt.h>

#define DRIVER_FILE_TAG 'hsrD'
#define SECTIONS_TAG 'ceSd'
#define MAX_DRIVER_FILE_SIZE 0x10000000
#define MAX_SECTIONS 96

static NTSTATUS read_file_from_disk(PUNICODE_STRING file_path, PVOID* out_buffer, ULONG* out_size) {
    OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES         obj_attr;
    IO_STATUS_BLOCK           io_status;
    HANDLE                    file_handle = NULL;
    NTSTATUS                  status = STATUS_SUCCESS;
    FILE_STANDARD_INFORMATION file_info = {};
    PVOID                     buffer = NULL;
    ULONG                     file_size = 0;
    LARGE_INTEGER             byte_offset = {};

    *out_buffer = NULL;
    *out_size = 0;

    InitializeObjectAttributes(
        &obj_attr,
        file_path,
        OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE | OBJ_KERNEL_HANDLE,
        NULL,
        NULL
    );

    status = ZwCreateFile(
        &file_handle,
        GENERIC_READ | SYNCHRONIZE,
        &obj_attr,
        &io_status,
        NULL,
        FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL,
        FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE,
        FILE_OPEN,
        FILE_SYNCHRONOUS_IO_NONALERT | FILE_NON_DIRECTORY_FILE,
        NULL,
        0
    );
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status))
        return status;

    status = ZwQueryInformationFile(
        file_handle,
        &io_status,
        &file_info,
        sizeof(file_info),
        FileStandardInformation
    );
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status))
        goto cleanup;

    if (file_info.EndOfFile.QuadPart <= 0 || file_info.EndOfFile.QuadPart > MAX_DRIVER_FILE_SIZE) {
        status = STATUS_FILE_TOO_LARGE;
        goto cleanup;
    }

    file_size = (ULONG)file_info.EndOfFile.QuadPart;

    // Paged pool is enough, everything here runs at PASSIVE_LEVEL
    buffer = ExAllocatePool2(POOL_FLAG_PAGED, file_size, DRIVER_FILE_TAG);
    if (!buffer) {
        status = STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES;
        goto cleanup;
    }

    status = ZwReadFile(
        file_handle,
        NULL,
        NULL,
        NULL,
        &io_status,
        buffer,
        file_size,
        &byte_offset,
        NULL
    );
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        ExFreePoolWithTag(buffer, DRIVER_FILE_TAG);
        goto cleanup;
    }

    if (io_status.Information != file_size) {
        ExFreePoolWithTag(buffer, DRIVER_FILE_TAG);
        status = STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL;
        goto cleanup;
    }

    *out_buffer = buffer;
    *out_size = file_size;

cleanup:
    ZwClose(file_handle);
    return status;
}

static NTSTATUS hash_chunk(BCRYPT_HASH_HANDLE h_hash, PVOID data, ULONG size) {
    if (size == 0)
        return STATUS_SUCCESS;
    return BCryptHashData(h_hash, (PUCHAR)data, size, 0);
}

NTSTATUS compute_sha256(PVOID data, ULONG data_size, UCHAR output[HASH_SIZE_SHA256]) {
    BCRYPT_ALG_HANDLE  h_alg = NULL;
    BCRYPT_HASH_HANDLE h_hash = NULL;
    NTSTATUS           status;

    status = BCryptOpenAlgorithmProvider(&h_alg, BCRYPT_SHA256_ALGORITHM, NULL, 0);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status))
        return status;

    status = BCryptCreateHash(h_alg, &h_hash, NULL, 0, NULL, 0, 0);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status))
        goto cleanup;

    status = hash_chunk(h_hash, data, data_size);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status))
        goto cleanup;

    status = BCryptFinishHash(h_hash, output, HASH_SIZE_SHA256, 0);

cleanup:
    if (h_hash) BCryptDestroyHash(h_hash);
    if (h_alg)  BCryptCloseAlgorithmProvider(h_alg, 0);
    return status;
}

static NTSTATUS compute_authentihash(PVOID file_data, ULONG file_size, UCHAR output[HASH_SIZE_SHA256]) {
    BCRYPT_ALG_HANDLE        h_alg = NULL;
    BCRYPT_HASH_HANDLE       h_hash = NULL;
    NTSTATUS                 status = STATUS_SUCCESS;
    PIMAGE_DOS_HEADER        dos_header = NULL;
    PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64      nt_headers = NULL;
    PIMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64 opt_header = NULL;
    PIMAGE_SECTION_HEADER    sorted_sections = NULL;
    ULONG                    checksum_offset = 0;
    ULONG                    sec_dir_offset = 0;
    ULONG                    after_checksum = 0;
    ULONG                    after_sec_dir = 0;
    ULONG                    header_size = 0;
    ULONG                    file_end_offset = 0;
    ULONG                    min_opt_header_size = 0;
    ULONGLONG                sum_of_bytes_hashed = 0;
    ULONGLONG                first_section_offset = 0;
    USHORT                   num_sections = 0;
    SIZE_T                   sections_bytes = 0;
    BOOLEAN                  has_sec_dir = FALSE;
    IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY     sec_dir = {};

    __try {
        if (file_size < sizeof(IMAGE_DOS_HEADER)) {
            status = STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT;
            goto cleanup;
        }

        dos_header = (PIMAGE_DOS_HEADER)file_data;
        if (dos_header->e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE) {
            status = STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT;
            goto cleanup;
        }

        if (dos_header->e_lfanew < (LONG)sizeof(IMAGE_DOS_HEADER) ||
            (ULONGLONG)dos_header->e_lfanew + sizeof(IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64) > file_size) {
            status = STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT;
            goto cleanup;
        }

        nt_headers = (PIMAGE_NT_HEADERS64)((PUCHAR)file_data + dos_header->e_lfanew);

        if (nt_headers->Signature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE) {
            status = STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT;
            goto cleanup;
        }

        // 64-bit images only
        if (nt_headers->OptionalHeader.Magic != IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR64_MAGIC) {
            status = STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT;
            goto cleanup;
        }

        opt_header = &nt_headers->OptionalHeader;

        checksum_offset = (ULONG)dos_header->e_lfanew
            + FIELD_OFFSET(IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64, OptionalHeader)
            + FIELD_OFFSET(IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64, CheckSum);
        after_checksum = checksum_offset + sizeof(ULONG);

        header_size = opt_header->SizeOfHeaders;
        if (header_size > file_size || header_size < after_checksum) {
            status = STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT;
            goto cleanup;
        }

        // The security directory entry may not exist in small optional headers
        min_opt_header_size = FIELD_OFFSET(IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64, DataDirectory)
            + (IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_SECURITY + 1) * sizeof(IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY);

        has_sec_dir = opt_header->NumberOfRvaAndSizes > IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_SECURITY &&
                    nt_headers->FileHeader.SizeOfOptionalHeader >= min_opt_header_size;

        if (has_sec_dir) {
            sec_dir_offset = (ULONG)dos_header->e_lfanew
                + FIELD_OFFSET(IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64, OptionalHeader)
                + FIELD_OFFSET(IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER64, DataDirectory)
                + IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_SECURITY * sizeof(IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY);
            after_sec_dir = sec_dir_offset + (ULONG)sizeof(IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY);

            if (header_size < after_sec_dir) {
                status = STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT;
                goto cleanup;
            }
            sec_dir = opt_header->DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_SECURITY];
        }

        // Validate section headers before touching them
        num_sections = nt_headers->FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
        if (num_sections == 0 || num_sections > MAX_SECTIONS) {
            status = STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT;
            goto cleanup;
        }

        sections_bytes = (SIZE_T)num_sections * sizeof(IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER);
        first_section_offset = (ULONGLONG)dos_header->e_lfanew
            + FIELD_OFFSET(IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64, OptionalHeader)
            + nt_headers->FileHeader.SizeOfOptionalHeader;

        if (first_section_offset > file_size || sections_bytes > file_size - first_section_offset) {
            status = STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT;
            goto cleanup;
        }

        // Validate certificate table location
        file_end_offset = file_size;
        if (sec_dir.VirtualAddress != 0 && sec_dir.Size != 0) {
            if (sec_dir.VirtualAddress > file_size || sec_dir.Size > file_size - sec_dir.VirtualAddress) {
                status = STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT;
                goto cleanup;
            }
            file_end_offset = sec_dir.VirtualAddress;
        }

        sorted_sections = (PIMAGE_SECTION_HEADER)ExAllocatePool2(
            POOL_FLAG_PAGED, sections_bytes, SECTIONS_TAG);
        if (!sorted_sections) {
            status = STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES;
            goto cleanup;
        }

        RtlCopyMemory(sorted_sections, (PUCHAR)file_data + first_section_offset, sections_bytes);

        // Insertion sort by PointerToRawData
        for (LONG i = 1; i < (LONG)num_sections; i++) {
            IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER tmp = sorted_sections[i];
            LONG j = i - 1;
            while (j >= 0 && sorted_sections[j].PointerToRawData > tmp.PointerToRawData) {
                sorted_sections[j + 1] = sorted_sections[j];
                j--;
            }
            sorted_sections[j + 1] = tmp;
        }

        status = BCryptOpenAlgorithmProvider(&h_alg, BCRYPT_SHA256_ALGORITHM, NULL, 0);
        if (!NT_SUCCESS(status))
            goto cleanup;

        status = BCryptCreateHash(h_alg, &h_hash, NULL, 0, NULL, 0, 0);
        if (!NT_SUCCESS(status))
            goto cleanup;

        // Headers: skip CheckSum and the security directory entry
        status = hash_chunk(h_hash, file_data, checksum_offset);
        if (!NT_SUCCESS(status))
            goto cleanup;

        if (has_sec_dir) {
            status = hash_chunk(h_hash, (PUCHAR)file_data + after_checksum, sec_dir_offset - after_checksum);
            if (!NT_SUCCESS(status))
                goto cleanup;

            status = hash_chunk(h_hash, (PUCHAR)file_data + after_sec_dir, header_size - after_sec_dir);
            if (!NT_SUCCESS(status))
                goto cleanup;
        }
        else {
            status = hash_chunk(h_hash, (PUCHAR)file_data + after_checksum, header_size - after_checksum);
            if (!NT_SUCCESS(status))
                goto cleanup;
        }

        sum_of_bytes_hashed = header_size;

        // Sections in file order
        for (USHORT i = 0; i < num_sections; i++) {
            ULONG raw_offset = sorted_sections[i].PointerToRawData;
            ULONG raw_size = sorted_sections[i].SizeOfRawData;

            if (raw_size == 0)
                continue;

            if ((ULONGLONG)raw_offset + raw_size > file_size) {
                status = STATUS_INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT;
                goto cleanup;
            }

            status = hash_chunk(h_hash, (PUCHAR)file_data + raw_offset, raw_size);
            if (!NT_SUCCESS(status))
                goto cleanup;

            sum_of_bytes_hashed += raw_size;
        }

        // Extra data after the last section, up to the certificate table
        if (sum_of_bytes_hashed < file_end_offset) {
            status = hash_chunk(h_hash,
                (PUCHAR)file_data + (ULONG)sum_of_bytes_hashed,
                file_end_offset - (ULONG)sum_of_bytes_hashed);
            if (!NT_SUCCESS(status))
                goto cleanup;
        }

        status = BCryptFinishHash(h_hash, output, HASH_SIZE_SHA256, 0);
    }
    __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
        status = STATUS_ACCESS_VIOLATION;
    }

cleanup:
    if (sorted_sections) ExFreePoolWithTag(sorted_sections, SECTIONS_TAG);
    if (h_hash)          BCryptDestroyHash(h_hash);
    if (h_alg)           BCryptCloseAlgorithmProvider(h_alg, 0);
    return status;
}

NTSTATUS compute_driver_hashes(PUNICODE_STRING full_image_name, PDRIVER_HASHES out_hashes) {
    PVOID    file_buffer = NULL;
    ULONG    file_size = 0;
    NTSTATUS status;

    if (!full_image_name || !out_hashes)
        return STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER;

    RtlZeroMemory(out_hashes, sizeof(DRIVER_HASHES));

    status = read_file_from_disk(full_image_name, &file_buffer, &file_size);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status))
        return status;

    status = compute_sha256(file_buffer, file_size, out_hashes->sha256);
    out_hashes->sha256_valid = NT_SUCCESS(status);

    status = compute_authentihash(file_buffer, file_size, out_hashes->authentihash);
    out_hashes->authentihash_valid = NT_SUCCESS(status);

    ExFreePoolWithTag(file_buffer, DRIVER_FILE_TAG);

    return (out_hashes->sha256_valid || out_hashes->authentihash_valid)
        ? STATUS_SUCCESS
        : STATUS_UNSUCCESSFUL;
}
```

`driver/sdk/pe/pe.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "pe.hpp"

// Minimal vector, no STL in kernel


template <typename T>
void vector_free(Vector<T>* v)
{
    if (v->data != NULL) {
        ExFreePoolWithTag(v->data, PE_TAG);
    }
    v->data = NULL;
    v->count = 0;
}

// Allocates a zeroed array of count elements. Old contents are freed.
template <typename T>
BOOLEAN vector_resize(Vector<T>* v, SIZE_T count)
{
    vector_free(v);
    if (count == 0) {
        return TRUE;
    }
    if (count > ((SIZE_T)-1) / sizeof(T)) {
        return FALSE;
    }
    v->data = (T*)ExAllocatePool2(POOL_FLAG_PAGED, count * sizeof(T), PE_TAG);
    if (v->data == NULL) {
        return FALSE;
    }
    v->count = count;
    return TRUE;
}

void free_pe(PE* pe)
{
    for (SIZE_T i = 0; i < pe->sections.count; i++) {
        vector_free(&pe->sections.data[i].data);
    }
    vector_free(&pe->sections);
    pe->valid = FALSE;
}

// Parses dos, nt and section headers from a buffer that starts at the file start / image base.
// Allocates pe->sections (headers only, data is empty).
static BOOLEAN parse_headers(const UCHAR* buf, SIZE_T size, PE* pe)
{
    if (size < sizeof(IMAGE_DOS_HEADER)) {
        return FALSE;
    }
    RtlCopyMemory(&pe->dos, buf, sizeof(IMAGE_DOS_HEADER));
    if (pe->dos.e_magic != IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    if (pe->dos.e_lfanew < (LONG)sizeof(IMAGE_DOS_HEADER)) {
        return FALSE;
    }
    SIZE_T nt_off = (SIZE_T)pe->dos.e_lfanew;
    if (nt_off > size || size - nt_off < sizeof(IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64)) {
        return FALSE;
    }
    RtlCopyMemory(&pe->nt, buf + nt_off, sizeof(IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64));
    if (pe->nt.Signature != IMAGE_NT_SIGNATURE) {
        return FALSE;
    }
    if (pe->nt.OptionalHeader.Magic != IMAGE_NT_OPTIONAL_HDR64_MAGIC) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    SIZE_T count = pe->nt.FileHeader.NumberOfSections;
    SIZE_T sec_off = nt_off + sizeof(ULONG) + sizeof(IMAGE_FILE_HEADER) + pe->nt.FileHeader.SizeOfOptionalHeader;
    if (count > 96 || sec_off > size) {
        return FALSE;
    }
    if ((size - sec_off) / sizeof(IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER) < count) {
        return FALSE;
    }

    if (!vector_resize(&pe->sections, count)) {
        return FALSE;
    }
    for (SIZE_T i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        RtlCopyMemory(&pe->sections.data[i].header, buf + sec_off + i * sizeof(IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER), sizeof(IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER));
    }
    return TRUE;
}

// Reads a PE64 from a file. Section data is the raw file data (SizeOfRawData bytes).
// path is an NT path, for example L"\\??\\C:\\Windows\\System32\\ntdll.dll". Must run at PASSIVE_LEVEL.
PE read_pe_from_disk(PUNICODE_STRING path)
{
    PE pe;
    RtlZeroMemory(&pe, sizeof(pe));

    OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES attributes;
    InitializeObjectAttributes(&attributes, path, OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE | OBJ_KERNEL_HANDLE, NULL, NULL);

    HANDLE file = NULL;
    IO_STATUS_BLOCK io;
    NTSTATUS status = ZwCreateFile(&file, GENERIC_READ | SYNCHRONIZE, &attributes, &io, NULL,
                                   FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, FILE_SHARE_READ, FILE_OPEN,
                                   FILE_SYNCHRONOUS_IO_NONALERT | FILE_NON_DIRECTORY_FILE, NULL, 0);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        return pe;
    }

    FILE_STANDARD_INFORMATION info;
    status = ZwQueryInformationFile(file, &io, &info, sizeof(info), FileStandardInformation);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status) || info.EndOfFile.QuadPart <= 0 || info.EndOfFile.QuadPart > PE_MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
        ZwClose(file);
        return pe;
    }
    ULONG file_size = (ULONG)info.EndOfFile.QuadPart;

    Vector<UCHAR> buf = {};
    if (!vector_resize(&buf, file_size)) {
        ZwClose(file);
        return pe;
    }

    status = ZwReadFile(file, NULL, NULL, NULL, &io, buf.data, file_size, NULL, NULL);
    ZwClose(file);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status) || io.Information != file_size) {
        vector_free(&buf);
        return pe;
    }

    if (!parse_headers(buf.data, buf.count, &pe)) {
        free_pe(&pe);
        vector_free(&buf);
        return pe;
    }

    for (SIZE_T i = 0; i < pe.sections.count; i++) {
        SECTION* section = &pe.sections.data[i];
        ULONG offset = section->header.PointerToRawData;
        ULONG raw_size = section->header.SizeOfRawData;

        if (raw_size == 0 || offset >= file_size) {
            continue;
        }
        if (raw_size > file_size - offset) {
            raw_size = file_size - offset;
        }
        if (!vector_resize(&section->data, raw_size)) {
            free_pe(&pe);
            vector_free(&buf);
            return pe;
        }
        RtlCopyMemory(section->data.data, buf.data + offset, raw_size);
    }

    vector_free(&buf);
    pe.valid = TRUE;
    return pe;
}

static BOOLEAN read_process_memory(PEPROCESS process, PVOID address, PVOID out, SIZE_T size)
{
    SIZE_T copied = 0;
    NTSTATUS status = MmCopyVirtualMemory(process, address, PsGetCurrentProcess(), out, size, KernelMode, &copied);
    return NT_SUCCESS(status) && copied == size;
}

// Reads a PE64 module from a running process. base is the module base address in that process.
// Section data is the in-memory data (VirtualSize bytes), as currently mapped.
// Must run at PASSIVE_LEVEL.
PE read_pe_from_pid(HANDLE pid, PVOID base)
{
    PE pe;
    RtlZeroMemory(&pe, sizeof(pe));

    PEPROCESS process = NULL;
    NTSTATUS status = PsLookupProcessByProcessId(pid, &process);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
        return pe;
    }
    if (PsGetProcessExitStatus(process) != STATUS_PENDING) {
        ObDereferenceObject(process);
        return pe;
    }

    Vector<UCHAR> header_buf = {};
    if (!vector_resize(&header_buf, PE_HEADER_READ_SIZE)) {
        ObDereferenceObject(process);
        return pe;
    }
    if (!read_process_memory(process, base, header_buf.data, header_buf.count)) {
        vector_free(&header_buf);
        ObDereferenceObject(process);
        return pe;
    }

    BOOLEAN parsed = parse_headers(header_buf.data, header_buf.count, &pe);
    vector_free(&header_buf);
    if (!parsed) {
        free_pe(&pe);
        ObDereferenceObject(process);
        return pe;
    }

    for (SIZE_T i = 0; i < pe.sections.count; i++) {
        SECTION* section = &pe.sections.data[i];
        ULONG size = section->header.Misc.VirtualSize;
        if (size == 0) {
            size = section->header.SizeOfRawData;
        }
        if (size == 0) {
            continue;
        }

        ULONG rva = section->header.VirtualAddress;
        if (size > PE_MAX_SECTION_SIZE || rva >= pe.nt.OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage ||
            size > pe.nt.OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage - rva) {
            free_pe(&pe);
            ObDereferenceObject(process);
            return pe;
        }

        if (!vector_resize(&section->data, size) ||
            !read_process_memory(process, (PUCHAR)base + rva, section->data.data, size)) {
            free_pe(&pe);
            ObDereferenceObject(process);
            return pe;
        }
    }

    ObDereferenceObject(process);
    pe.valid = TRUE;
    return pe;
}

SECTION* find_section_by_name(PE* pe, const char* name)
{
    for (SIZE_T i = 0; i < pe->sections.count; i++) {
        SECTION* section = &pe->sections.data[i];
        if (RtlCompareMemory(section->header.Name, name, strlen(name)) == strlen(name) &&
            (strlen(name) == IMAGE_SIZEOF_SHORT_NAME || section->header.Name[strlen(name)] == '\0')) {
            return section;
        }
    }
    return NULL;
}

// Same as read_pe_from_disk, but works on an already-open HANDLE instead of
// resolving a path. Use this when the handle came from ObOpenObjectByPointer
// over a FILE_OBJECT you already have (e.g. PsReferenceProcessFilePointer),
// to avoid reopening by path (TOCTOU).
//
// Ownership: this function does NOT close `file`. The caller opened it and
// the caller is responsible for ZwClose.
//
// Note: unlike read_pe_from_disk, we don't control how this handle/file
// object was opened, so we can't assume FILE_SYNCHRONOUS_IO_NONALERT is set.
// ZwReadFile can legitimately return STATUS_PENDING on an async file object,
// so we wait on an event explicitly instead of assuming synchronous completion.
PE read_pe_from_handle(HANDLE file)
{
    PE pe;
    RtlZeroMemory(&pe, sizeof(pe));

    FILE_STANDARD_INFORMATION info;
    IO_STATUS_BLOCK io;
    NTSTATUS status = ZwQueryInformationFile(file, &io, &info, sizeof(info), FileStandardInformation);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status) || info.EndOfFile.QuadPart <= 0 || info.EndOfFile.QuadPart > PE_MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
        return pe;
    }
    ULONG file_size = (ULONG)info.EndOfFile.QuadPart;

    Vector<UCHAR> buf = {};
    if (!vector_resize(&buf, file_size)) {
        return pe;
    }

    KEVENT event;
    KeInitializeEvent(&event, NotificationEvent, FALSE);

    LARGE_INTEGER offset;
    offset.QuadPart = 0;

    status = ZwReadFile(file, &event, NULL, NULL, &io, buf.data, file_size, &offset, NULL);
    // the file object may be asynchronous, so wait on our own event if it returns STATUS_PENDING
    if (status == STATUS_PENDING) {
        status = KeWaitForSingleObject(&event, Executive, KernelMode, FALSE, NULL);
        if (NT_SUCCESS(status)) {
            status = io.Status;
        }
    }

    if (!NT_SUCCESS(status) || io.Information != file_size) {
        vector_free(&buf);
        return pe;
    }

    if (!parse_headers(buf.data, buf.count, &pe)) {
        free_pe(&pe);
        vector_free(&buf);
        return pe;
    }

    for (SIZE_T i = 0; i < pe.sections.count; i++) {
        SECTION* section = &pe.sections.data[i];
        ULONG offset_raw = section->header.PointerToRawData;
        ULONG raw_size = section->header.SizeOfRawData;

        if (raw_size == 0 || offset_raw >= file_size) {
            continue;
        }
        if (raw_size > file_size - offset_raw) {
            raw_size = file_size - offset_raw;
        }
        if (!vector_resize(&section->data, raw_size)) {
            free_pe(&pe);
            vector_free(&buf);
            return pe;
        }
        RtlCopyMemory(section->data.data, buf.data + offset_raw, raw_size);
    }

    vector_free(&buf);
    pe.valid = TRUE;
    return pe;
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <ntifs.h>

#define PE_TAG 'epEP'

#define PE_MAX_FILE_SIZE 0x10000000
#define PE_MAX_SECTION_SIZE 0x10000000

template <typename T>
struct Vector {
    T* data;
    SIZE_T count;
};

struct SECTION {
    IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER header;
    Vector<UCHAR> data;
};

struct PE {
    BOOLEAN valid;
    IMAGE_DOS_HEADER dos;
    IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64 nt;
    Vector<SECTION> sections;
};

extern "C" NTSTATUS NTAPI MmCopyVirtualMemory(
    PEPROCESS source_process,
    PVOID source_address,
    PEPROCESS target_process,
    PVOID target_address,
    SIZE_T buffer_size,
    KPROCESSOR_MODE previous_mode,
    PSIZE_T return_size);

PE read_pe_from_pid(HANDLE pid, PVOID base);
```

`scripts/build-all.ps1`:

```ps1
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [ValidateSet('Debug', 'Release')]
    [string]$Configuration = 'Debug',
    [string]$Generator = 'Visual Studio 18 2026',
    [switch]$SkipDriver,
    [switch]$SkipClient,
    [switch]$SkipServer,
    [switch]$SkipSign,
    [switch]$EnableTestSigning
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$repoRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$buildDir = Join-Path $repoRoot 'build'

$buildDriver = -not $SkipDriver
$buildClient = -not $SkipClient
$buildServer = -not $SkipServer

function To-CMakeBool([bool]$Value) { if ($Value) { 'ON' } else { 'OFF' } }

# 1. Asegurar el WDK (usado por find_package(WDK) -> FindWDK.cmake).
$contentRoot = Join-Path $repoRoot 'toolchains\wdk\c'
if (-not $env:WDKContentRoot -and -not (Test-Path (Join-Path $contentRoot 'Include'))) {
    Write-Host '[build-all] No se encontro WDK; descargando ...'
    & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'fetch-wdk.ps1') | Out-Null
}
if (Test-Path (Join-Path $contentRoot 'Include')) {
    $env:WDKContentRoot = $contentRoot
}
if ($buildDriver -and -not $env:WDKContentRoot) {
    throw 'No hay WDK disponible. Ejecuta scripts/fetch-wdk.ps1.'
}
if ($env:WDKContentRoot) {
    Write-Host "[build-all] WDKContentRoot = $env:WDKContentRoot"
}

# 2. Configurar.
Write-Host "[build-all] Configurando CMake ($Generator, x64) ..."
cmake -S $repoRoot -B $buildDir -G $Generator -A x64 `
    "-DRINGO_BUILD_DRIVER=$(To-CMakeBool $buildDriver)" `
    "-DRINGO_BUILD_CLIENT=$(To-CMakeBool $buildClient)" `
    "-DRINGO_BUILD_SERVER=$(To-CMakeBool $buildServer)"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'CMake configure fallo.' }

# 3. Compilar.
$targets = @()
if ($buildDriver) { $targets += 'driver' }
if ($buildClient) { $targets += 'client' }
if ($buildServer) { $targets += 'ringo-server' }

foreach ($target in $targets) {
    Write-Host "[build-all] Compilando '$target' ($Configuration) ..."
    cmake --build $buildDir --config $Configuration --target $target
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Fallo la compilacion de '$target'." }
}

# 4. Firmar (test signing).
if ($buildDriver -and -not $SkipSign) {
    $driver = Join-Path $buildDir 'bin\rngdrv.sys'
    $signArgs = @{ DriverPath = $driver }
    if ($EnableTestSigning) { $signArgs['EnableTestSigning'] = $true }
    & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'sign-driver.ps1') @signArgs
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'La firma del driver fallo.' }
}

Write-Host "[build-all] Listo. Binarios en $(Join-Path $buildDir 'bin')"

```

`scripts/fetch-wdk.ps1`:

```ps1
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$Version = '10.0.26100.6584'
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$repoRoot      = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$toolchainsDir = Join-Path $repoRoot 'toolchains'
$wdkRoot       = Join-Path $toolchainsDir 'wdk'
$contentRoot   = Join-Path $wdkRoot 'c'

if (Test-Path (Join-Path $contentRoot 'Include')) {
    Write-Host "[fetch-wdk] WDK ya presente en $contentRoot"
    return $contentRoot
}

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $toolchainsDir | Out-Null

$url   = "https://api.nuget.org/v3-flatcontainer/microsoft.windows.wdk.x64/$Version/microsoft.windows.wdk.x64.$Version.nupkg"
$nupkg = Join-Path $toolchainsDir 'wdk.nupkg'
$zip   = Join-Path $toolchainsDir 'wdk.zip'

Write-Host "[fetch-wdk] Descargando WDK $Version desde nuget.org ..."
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $nupkg -UseBasicParsing

Copy-Item $nupkg $zip -Force
if (Test-Path $wdkRoot) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $wdkRoot }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $wdkRoot | Out-Null
Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $zip -DestinationPath $wdkRoot -Force
Remove-Item $zip -Force

if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $contentRoot 'Include'))) {
    throw "El paquete WDK no contiene el directorio esperado 'c/Include'."
}

Write-Host "[fetch-wdk] WDK extraido en $contentRoot"
return $contentRoot

```

`scripts/gen-compile-commands.ps1`:

```ps1
# Genera la base de datos de compilacion (compile_commands.json) que clangd usa
# en Zed para el driver, el cliente y el server.
#
# Por que un build aparte (build-index/):
#   - El generador "Visual Studio" no puede exportar compile_commands.json.
#   - Ninja a secas toma el GCC de MSYS2 que esta en el PATH, y clangd terminaria
#     mezclando headers de MinGW con flags de MSVC. Por eso pasamos por vcvars64.bat.
#   - Es solo para el LSP: no genera binarios ni reemplaza a build/.
#
# Uso:  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\gen-compile-commands.ps1

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [switch]$Clean
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$repoRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$buildDir = Join-Path $repoRoot 'build-index'

# 1. WDK local (lo usa find_package(WDK) -> FindWDK.cmake).
if (-not $env:WDKContentRoot) {
    $contentRoot = Join-Path $repoRoot 'toolchains\wdk\c'
    if (Test-Path (Join-Path $contentRoot 'Include')) {
        $env:WDKContentRoot = $contentRoot
    } else {
        throw 'No hay WDK. Ejecuta scripts/fetch-wdk.ps1.'
    }
}
Write-Host "[index] WDKContentRoot = $env:WDKContentRoot"

# 2. Entorno MSVC (vcvars64.bat).
$vcvars = Get-ChildItem @(
    "$env:ProgramFiles\Microsoft Visual Studio\*\*\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat"
    "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\*\*\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat"
) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object FullName -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
if (-not $vcvars) {
    throw 'No encontre vcvars64.bat. Instala Visual Studio con "Desktop development with C++".'
}
Write-Host "[index] vcvars = $vcvars"

if ($Clean -and (Test-Path $buildDir)) {
    Write-Host "[index] Borrando $buildDir ..."
    Remove-Item $buildDir -Recurse -Force
}

# 3. Configure con el preset "index" (Ninja + MSVC + CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS).
#    vcvars64.bat es un .bat: hay que llamarlo desde cmd.
$configure = 'set "WDKContentRoot=' + $env:WDKContentRoot + '" && ' +
             'call "' + $vcvars + '" >nul && ' +
             'cd /d "' + $repoRoot + '" && ' +
             'cmake --preset index'
Write-Host '[index] cmake --preset index ...'
cmd /c $configure
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Fallo el configure de build-index.' }

# 4. Verificar.
$db = Join-Path $buildDir 'compile_commands.json'
if (-not (Test-Path $db)) { throw "No se genero $db" }
$entradas = ConvertFrom-Json (Get-Content $db -Raw)
$count = $entradas.Count
Write-Host "[index] OK: $count entradas en $db"
Write-Host '[index] clangd lo lee via .clangd (CompileFlags.CompilationDatabase: build-index).'

```

`scripts/sign-driver.ps1`:

```ps1
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$DriverPath,
    [string]$CertSubject = 'CN=Ringo Test Driver',
    [switch]$SkipTrust,
    [switch]$EnableTestSigning
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$repoRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
if (-not $DriverPath) {
    $DriverPath = Join-Path $repoRoot 'build\bin\rngdrv.sys'
}
if (-not (Test-Path $DriverPath)) {
    throw "No existe el driver a firmar: $DriverPath"
}

function Get-SignTool {
    $kitsBin = 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\bin'
    $candidates = Get-ChildItem $kitsBin -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^\d+\.\d+' } |
        Sort-Object { [version]$_.Name } -Descending
    foreach ($dir in $candidates) {
        $exe = Join-Path $dir.FullName 'x64\signtool.exe'
        if (Test-Path $exe) { return $exe }
    }
    throw 'No se encontro signtool.exe. Instala el Windows SDK.'
}

function Add-CertToStore {
    param(
        [System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Certificate2]$Cert,
        [string]$Name,
        [string]$Location
    )
    $store = New-Object System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.X509Store($Name, $Location)
    $store.Open([System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates.OpenFlags]::ReadWrite)
    $store.Add($Cert)
    $store.Close()
}

$signtool = Get-SignTool

# Certificado de prueba autofirmado (code signing EKU)
$cert = Get-ChildItem Cert:\CurrentUser\My |
    Where-Object { $_.Subject -eq $CertSubject } |
    Sort-Object NotAfter -Descending |
    Select-Object -First 1

if (-not $cert) {
    Write-Host "[sign] Creando certificado autofirmado de prueba '$CertSubject' ..."
    $cert = New-SelfSignedCertificate `
        -Type CodeSigningCert `
        -Subject $CertSubject `
        -CertStoreLocation 'Cert:\CurrentUser\My' `
        -KeyAlgorithm RSA `
        -KeyLength 2048 `
        -HashAlgorithm SHA256 `
        -NotAfter (Get-Date).AddYears(5)
}

Write-Host "[sign] Certificado: $($cert.Subject) [$($cert.Thumbprint)]"

# Para test signing el certificado debe ser de confianza en la maquina.
if (-not $SkipTrust) {
    foreach ($storeName in @('Root', 'TrustedPublisher')) {
        try {
            Add-CertToStore -Cert $cert -Name $storeName -Location 'LocalMachine'
            Write-Host "[sign] Certificado importado en LocalMachine\$storeName"
        } catch {
            Write-Warning "[sign] No se pudo importar en LocalMachine\$storeName (requiere admin)."
        }
    }
}

Write-Host "[sign] Firmando $DriverPath ..."
& $signtool sign /v /fd SHA256 /s My /sha1 $cert.Thumbprint $DriverPath
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "signtool fallo al firmar (codigo $LASTEXITCODE)."
}

cmd /c "`"$signtool`" verify /v /pa `"$DriverPath`" 2>&1" | Out-Host
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Warning '[sign] La verificacion reporto que el certificado no es de confianza (normal sin admin: importalo en LocalMachine\Root / TrustedPublisher ejecutando como administrador).'
}

if ($EnableTestSigning) {
    Write-Host "[sign] Habilitando test signing (bcdedit /set testsigning on) ..."
    & bcdedit /set testsigning on
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Warning '[sign] No se pudo habilitar test signing (requiere admin).'
    } else {
        Write-Host '[sign] Test signing habilitado. Reinicia Windows para aplicarlo.'
    }
}

Write-Host '[sign] Firmado.'
exit 0

```

`server/core/analysis/engine.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "engine.hpp"
#include "../db/verdict.hpp"
#include <cmath>
#include <ctime>
#include "core/analysis/rules/manual_mapped_drivers/manual_mapped_drivers.hpp"
#include "core/analysis/rules/byovd/byovd.hpp"
#include "rules/integrity/integrity.hpp"
#include "rules/system/system.hpp"
#include <vector>

using Evidence = std::vector<EVIDENCE_ENTRY>;
static const float DECAY_PER_DAY = 0.9f;

RULE_RESULT found(const std::string& signal, const std::string& reason) {
    return { SIGNAL_WEIGHTS.at(signal), signal, reason };
}

static float decayed(float score, uint64_t last_updated, uint64_t now) {
    if (now <= last_updated) return score;
    double days = (double)(now - last_updated) / 86400.0;
    return score * (float)std::pow(DECAY_PER_DAY, days);
}

static void apply_results(const std::string& hwid, const std::vector<RULE_RESULT>& results) {
    PLAYER_RISK p = db::get_or_create(hwid);
    uint64_t now = (uint64_t)time(nullptr);

    // lower the old score
    p.risk_score = decayed(p.risk_score, p.last_updated, now);

    static const uint64_t DEDUP_WINDOW = 24 * 3600;   // same finding counts once every 24 h

    for (const auto& res : results) {
        if (res.signal.weight == 0) continue;   // no_finding

        // a ban is applied even if the signal was already counted
        if (res.signal.definitive) {
            p.status = VERDICT_STATUS::BANNED;
            p.ban_reason = res.reason;
        }

        // already counted recently: don't add again
        if (db::has_recent_evidence(hwid, res.reason, now - DEDUP_WINDOW))
            continue;

        p.risk_score += res.signal.weight;
        db::save_evidence(hwid, res.reason, res.signal.weight, now);
    }

    // status with the score
    if (p.status != VERDICT_STATUS::BANNED) {
        if (p.risk_score >= 75)      p.status = VERDICT_STATUS::BANNED;
        else if (p.risk_score >= 40) p.status = VERDICT_STATUS::FLAGGED;
        else                         p.status = VERDICT_STATUS::CLEAN;
    }

    p.last_updated = now;
    db::save_player_risk(p);
}

void engine::analyze_environment(const ENVIRONMENT_REPORT& r) {
    std::vector<RULE_RESULT> results = {
        rule_secure_boot(r),
        rule_hvci(r),
        rule_vbs(r),
        rule_hypervisor(r),
        rule_test_signing(r),
        rule_kernel_debugging(r),
        rule_tpm(r),
    };
    
    apply_results(r.hwid, results);
}

void engine::analyze_modules(const MODULE_REPORT& r) {
    std::vector<RULE_RESULT> results = {
        rule_manual_mapped(&r),
        rule_integrity_compromised(&r),
        rule_byovd(&r),
    };

    apply_results(r.hwid, results);
}
```

```cpp
#include "byovd.hpp"
#include "core/analysis/rules/rule.hpp"
#include "core/reporting/report_byovd/report_byovd.hpp"

RULE_RESULT rule_byovd(const MODULE_REPORT* r){
    const BYOVD_DETECTION_REPORT* rep = &r->byovd;

    for(unsigned long i = 0; i < rep->count; i++){
        if(rep->entries[i].method == METHOD_RUNTIME_SCAN)
            return found("byovd_loaded", "found byovd when loading ringo");
        if(rep->entries[i].method == METHOD_IMAGE_CALLBACK)
            return found("byovd_loaded", "byovd detected by image callback");
        if(rep->entries[i].method == METHOD_DRIVER_WALKING)
            return found("byovd_loaded", "byovd detected by walking drivers");
    }

    return no_finding();
}
```

```cpp
RULE_RESULT rule_integrity_compromised(const MODULE_REPORT* r) {
    const HASH_DIFF_REPORT* rep = &r->hash_diff;

    for(unsigned long i = 0; i < rep->count; i++){
        if(rep->entries[i].mismatch_type == PROCESS_WITH_PROCESS)
            return found("game_hash_mismatch", "process diff with process");
        if(rep->entries[i].mismatch_type == FILE_WITH_PROCESS)
            return found("game_hash_mismatch", "file diff with process");
    }

    return no_finding();
 }
```

`server/core/analysis/rules/manual_mapped_drivers/manual_mapped_drivers.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "manual_mapped_drivers.hpp"
#include "core/reporting/report_manual_mapped_driver/report_manual_mapped_driver.hpp"


static BOOLEAN address_in_range(PVOID address, PVOID base, SIZE_T size) {
    ULONG_PTR a = (ULONG_PTR)address;
    ULONG_PTR b = (ULONG_PTR)base;

    return a >= b && a < b + size;
}


RULE_RESULT rule_manual_mapped(const MODULE_REPORT* r){
    const MANUAL_MAPPED_DRIVER_DETECTION_REPORT* rep = &r->manual_mapped;

    bool pool_present = false;
    bool thread_present = false;

    for(long i = 0; i < rep->count; i++){
        if(rep->entries[i].method == METHOD_BIG_POOL)
            pool_present = true;
        else if(rep->entries[i].method == METHOD_KERNEL_SPACE_WALKING)
            thread_present = true;
    }

    for (LONG i = 0; i < rep->count; i++) {
        const MANUAL_MAPPED_DRIVER_DETECTION_ENTRY* t = &rep->entries[i];
        if (t->method == METHOD_BIG_POOL) continue;

        for (LONG k = 0; k < rep->count; k++) {
            const MANUAL_MAPPED_DRIVER_DETECTION_ENTRY* p = &rep->entries[k];
            if (p->method != METHOD_BIG_POOL) continue;

            if (address_in_range(t->suspicious_address, p->suspicious_address, p->size))
                return found("thread_inside_big_pool", "kernel thread running inside a big pool");
        }
    }

    if (thread_present)
        return found("kernel_thread_outside_valid_module", "kernel thread outside any signed driver");

    if (pool_present)
        return found("big_pool_detected", "non-whitelisted big pool allocation");

    return no_finding();
}
```

`server/core/analysis/rules/rule.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include "../../models/reports.hpp"
#include "../../models/player_risk.hpp"

struct SIGNAL {
    float weight; // how much it adds to the risk score
    bool definitive; // immediate ban
};

// this is the interface for the analysis
struct RULE_RESULT {
    SIGNAL signal;
    std::string signal_reason; // ex. "debugger_with_impossible_stats"
    std::string reason; // legible description, ex. "debugger present with KDA > 10"
};

// if didn't found nothing, use this
inline RULE_RESULT no_finding() {
    return {};
}   

// 0-39 -> clean
// 40-74 -> flagged
// 75-100 -> ban
static const std::map<std::string, SIGNAL> SIGNAL_WEIGHTS = {
    // weak
    { "hypervisor_detected",          { 15.0f, false } },
    { "debugger_present",             { 20.0f, false } },
    
    // mid
    { "byovd_loaded", { 35.0f, false } },
    { "big_pool_detected", { 35.0f, false } },

    // strong - almost ban with only one of things
    { "kernel_thread_outside_valid_module", { 70.0f, false } },
    { "thread_inside_big_pool", { 70.0f, false } },
    { "spoofing_detection", {70.0f, false } },
    { "unsigned_dll", {70.0f, false} },
    { "remote_thread", {70.0f, false}},
    
    // immediate ban
    { "test_signing_enabled",         { 10.0f, true } },
    { "hwid_previously_banned", { 100.0f, true } },
    { "game_hash_mismatch",  { 100.0f, true } },
    { "invalid_ioctl_sent",  { 100.0f, true } },
};
```

`server/core/analysis/rules/system/system.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/system/system.hpp"
#include "core/analysis/engine.hpp"

RULE_RESULT rule_secure_boot(const ENVIRONMENT_REPORT& r) {
    const auto& s = r.secure_boot;

    if(disagree(s.nt_query_enabled, s.uefi_var))
        return found("spoofing_detection", "secure boot: NtQuery vs UEFI variable disagree");
    if(disagree(s.nt_query_enabled, s.registry))
        return found("spoofing_detection", "secure boot: NtQuery vs Registry disagree");
    if(disagree(s.uefi_var, s.registry))
        return found("spoofing_detection", "secure boot: UEFI Variable vs Registry disagree");

    bool any_enabled = (s.nt_query_enabled.valid && s.nt_query_enabled.value)
                    || (s.uefi_var.valid && s.uefi_var.value)
                    || (s.registry.valid && s.registry.value);
    if (any_enabled && s.nt_query_capable.valid && !s.nt_query_capable.value)
        return found("spoofing_detection", "secure boot enabled but hardware not capable");

    return no_finding();
}

RULE_RESULT rule_hvci(const ENVIRONMENT_REPORT& r) {
    const auto& hvci = r.hvci.code_integrity;
    const auto& vbs_hvci = r.vbs.nt_query_hvci;
    const auto& secure_kernel = r.vbs.nt_query_secure_kernel;

    if (disagree(hvci, vbs_hvci))
        return found("spoofing_detection", "hvci: code integrity vs vbs query disagree");

    bool hvci_on = (hvci.valid && hvci.value) || (vbs_hvci.valid && vbs_hvci.value);
    if (hvci_on && secure_kernel.valid && !secure_kernel.value)
        return found("spoofing_detection", "hvci enabled but secure kernel not running");

    return no_finding();
}


RULE_RESULT rule_vbs(const ENVIRONMENT_REPORT& r) {
    const auto& secure_kernel = r.vbs.nt_query_secure_kernel;
    const auto& hv_nt         = r.hypervisor.nt_query;
    const auto& hv_cpuid      = r.hypervisor.cpuid;

    bool vbs_on = secure_kernel.valid && secure_kernel.value;

    if (vbs_on && hv_cpuid.valid && !hv_cpuid.value)
        return found("spoofing_detection", "vbs running but cpuid reports no hypervisor");
    if (vbs_on && hv_nt.valid && !hv_nt.value)
        return found("spoofing_detection", "vbs running but NtQuery reports no hypervisor");

    return no_finding();
}

RULE_RESULT rule_test_signing(const ENVIRONMENT_REPORT& r) {
    const auto& ts = r.test_signing.code_integrity;

    if (ts.valid && ts.value)
        return found("test_signing_enabled", "test signing mode is enabled");

    return no_finding();
}

RULE_RESULT rule_hypervisor(const ENVIRONMENT_REPORT& r) {
    const auto& nt    = r.hypervisor.nt_query;
    const auto& cpuid = r.hypervisor.cpuid;

    if (disagree(nt, cpuid))
        return found("spoofing_detection", "hypervisor: NtQuery vs CPUID disagree");

    bool hv_present = (nt.valid && nt.value) || (cpuid.valid && cpuid.value);
    bool vbs_running = r.vbs.nt_query_secure_kernel.valid && r.vbs.nt_query_secure_kernel.value;

    if (hv_present && !vbs_running)
        return found("hypervisor_detected", "hypervisor present without VBS");

    return no_finding();
}

RULE_RESULT rule_kernel_debugging(const ENVIRONMENT_REPORT& r) {
    const auto& enabled     = r.kernel_debugging.nt_query_enabled;
    const auto& not_present = r.kernel_debugging.nt_query_not_present;

    if (enabled.valid && not_present.valid && enabled.value == not_present.value)
        return found("spoofing_detection", "kernel debugging: enabled and not_present are inconsistent");

    if (enabled.valid && enabled.value)
        return found("debugger_present", "kernel debugger is enabled");

    return no_finding();
}

RULE_RESULT rule_tpm(const ENVIRONMENT_REPORT& r) {
    const auto& t20 = r.tpm.tpm_2_0;
    const auto& t12 = r.tpm.tpm_1_2;

    // los dos a la vez es imposible
    if (t20.valid && t20.value && t12.valid && t12.value)
        return found("spoofing_detection", "tpm: both 1.2 and 2.0 reported");

    return no_finding();
}
```

```cpp
#include "telemetry.hpp"
#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>
#include <memory>
#include "../../models/reports.hpp"
#include "../../db/reports.hpp" 
#include "core/db/db.hpp"
#include "core/analysis/engine.hpp"
#include <iostream>

using json = nlohmann::json;

void handle_environment_report(const httplib::Request& req, httplib::Response& res) {
    try {
        auto j = json::parse(req.body);
        ENVIRONMENT_REPORT report = j.get<ENVIRONMENT_REPORT>();

        db::save_environment_report(report); 
        engine::analyze_environment(report);

        res.status = 200;
        res.set_content("{\"status\":\"ok\"}", "application/json");
    }
    catch (const std::exception& e) {
        res.status = 400;
        res.set_content("{\"error\":\"invalid payload\"}", "application/json");
    }
}

void handle_module_report(const httplib::Request& req, httplib::Response& res) {
    try {
        auto j = json::parse(req.body);
        auto report = std::make_unique<MODULE_REPORT>();
        j.get_to(*report);

        db::save_module_report(report->hwid, report->timestamp, req.body);
        engine::analyze_modules(*report);

        res.status = 200;
        res.set_content("{\"status\":\"ok\"}", "application/json");
    }
    catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cerr << "[telemetry/module] " << e.what() << "\n";
        res.status = 400;
        res.set_content("{\"error\":\"invalid payload\"}", "application/json");
    }
}
```

```cpp
#include "verdict.hpp"
#include <nlohmann/json.hpp>
#include "core/db/verdict.hpp"

using json = nlohmann::json;

void handle_get_status(const httplib::Request& req, httplib::Response& res) {
    std::string hwid = req.path_params.at("hwid");

    if (hwid.empty()) {
        res.status = 400;
        res.set_content("{\"error\":\"missing hwid\"}", "application/json");
        return;
    }

    PLAYER_RISK p = db::get_or_create(hwid);

    const char* status_str = "clean";
    if (p.status == VERDICT_STATUS::BANNED)       status_str = "banned";
    else if (p.status == VERDICT_STATUS::FLAGGED) status_str = "flagged";

    json response = {
        { "hwid",       p.hwid },
        { "status",     status_str },
        { "reason",     p.ban_reason },
        { "risk_score", p.risk_score }
    };

    res.status = 200;
    res.set_content(response.dump(), "application/json");
}
```

`server/core/api/server.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/api/server.cpp
#include "server.hpp"
#include "routes/telemetry.hpp"
#include "routes/verdict.hpp"
#include <iostream>

RINGO_SERVER::RINGO_SERVER(const std::string& host, int port)
    : _host(host), _port(port) {}

void RINGO_SERVER::register_routes() {
    // telemetry sent by usermode
    _svr.Post("/telemetry/environment", handle_environment_report);
    _svr.Post("/telemetry/module",      handle_module_report);
    
    // the game server consults this
    _svr.Get("/status/:hwid",           handle_get_status);

    // health check, heartbeat
    _svr.Get("/health", [](const httplib::Request&, httplib::Response& res) {
        res.set_content("{\"status\":\"ok\"}", "application/json");
    });

    // 404
    _svr.set_error_handler([](const httplib::Request&, httplib::Response& res) {
        res.status = 404;
        res.set_content("{\"error\":\"not found\"}", "application/json");
    });
}

void RINGO_SERVER::start() {
    register_routes();
    std::cout << "[ringo] listening on " << _host << ":" << _port << "\n";
    _svr.listen(_host.c_str(), _port);
}
```

`server/core/db/db.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "db.hpp"
#include <iostream>

std::unique_ptr<SQLite::Database> g_db;

void db_init(const std::string& path) {
    g_db = std::make_unique<SQLite::Database>(path, SQLite::OPEN_READWRITE | SQLite::OPEN_CREATE);

    g_db->exec(R"(
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS environment_reports (
            id                   INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            hwid                 TEXT NOT NULL,
            timestamp            INTEGER NOT NULL,
            debugger_present     INTEGER NOT NULL,
            hypervisor_detected  INTEGER NOT NULL,
            secure_boot_enabled  INTEGER NOT NULL,
            hvci_enabled         INTEGER NOT NULL,
            test_signing_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,
            vbs_enabled          INTEGER NOT NULL
        );
    )");

    g_db->exec(R"(
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS module_reports (
            id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            hwid      TEXT    NOT NULL,
            timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL,
            payload   TEXT    NOT NULL
        );
    )");

    g_db->exec(R"(
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS player_risk (
            hwid         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            risk_score   REAL    NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            status       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            ban_reason   TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            last_updated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            first_seen   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
        );
    )");

    g_db->exec(R"(
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS evidence (
            id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            hwid      TEXT    NOT NULL,
            signal    TEXT    NOT NULL,
            weight    REAL    NOT NULL,
            timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL
        );
    )");

    std::cout << "[db] initialized at " << path << "\n";
}
```

```cpp
void save_environment_report(const ENVIRONMENT_REPORT& r) {

        INSERT INTO environment_reports
            (hwid, timestamp, debugger_present, hypervisor_detected,
             secure_boot_enabled, hvci_enabled, test_signing_enabled, vbs_enabled)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    )");

    stmt.bind(2, (int64_t)time(nullptr));
    stmt.bind(3, (int)r.kernel_debugging.nt_query_enabled.value);

    stmt.bind(5, (int)r.secure_boot.nt_query_enabled.value);
    stmt.bind(6, (int)r.hvci.code_integrity.value);
    stmt.bind(7, (int)r.test_signing.code_integrity.value);
```

`server/core/db/verdict.cpp`:

```cpp
// src/db/verdicts.cpp
#include "verdict.hpp"
#include "db.hpp"
#include <ctime>

namespace db {

PLAYER_RISK get_or_create(const std::string& hwid) {
    SQLite::Statement stmt(*g_db, "SELECT * FROM player_risk WHERE hwid = ?");
    stmt.bind(1, hwid);

    if (stmt.executeStep()) {
        PLAYER_RISK p;
        p.hwid         = stmt.getColumn(0).getString();
        p.risk_score   = (float)stmt.getColumn(1).getDouble();
        p.status       = (VERDICT_STATUS)stmt.getColumn(2).getInt();
        p.ban_reason   = stmt.getColumn(3).getString();
        p.last_updated = (uint64_t)stmt.getColumn(4).getInt64();
        p.first_seen   = (uint64_t)stmt.getColumn(5).getInt64();
        return p;
    }

    PLAYER_RISK p;
    p.hwid         = hwid;
    p.risk_score   = 0.0f;
    p.status       = VERDICT_STATUS::CLEAN;
    p.ban_reason   = "";
    p.last_updated = (uint64_t)time(nullptr);
    p.first_seen   = (uint64_t)time(nullptr);
    return p;
}

bool has_recent_evidence(const std::string& hwid, const std::string& signal, uint64_t since) {
    SQLite::Statement stmt(*g_db,
        "SELECT 1 FROM evidence WHERE hwid = ? AND signal = ? AND timestamp >= ? LIMIT 1");
    stmt.bind(1, hwid);
    stmt.bind(2, signal);
    stmt.bind(3, (int64_t)since);
    return stmt.executeStep();
}

void save_player_risk(const PLAYER_RISK& p) {
    SQLite::Statement stmt(*g_db, R"(
        INSERT INTO player_risk (hwid, risk_score, status, ban_reason, last_updated, first_seen)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(hwid) DO UPDATE SET
            risk_score   = excluded.risk_score,
            status       = excluded.status,
            ban_reason   = excluded.ban_reason,
            last_updated = excluded.last_updated
    )");
    stmt.bind(1, p.hwid);
    stmt.bind(2, (double)p.risk_score);
    stmt.bind(3, (int)p.status);
    stmt.bind(4, p.ban_reason);
    stmt.bind(5, (int64_t)p.last_updated);
    stmt.bind(6, (int64_t)p.first_seen);
    stmt.exec();
}

void save_evidence(const std::string& hwid, const std::string& signal, float weight, uint64_t timestamp) {
    SQLite::Statement stmt(*g_db, R"(
        INSERT INTO evidence (hwid, signal, weight, timestamp)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    )");
    stmt.bind(1, hwid);
    stmt.bind(2, signal);
    stmt.bind(3, (double)weight);
    stmt.bind(4, (int64_t)timestamp);
    stmt.exec();
}

}
```

```hpp
struct ENVIRONMENT_REPORT {
    std::string            hwid;
    SECURE_BOOT_CHECK      secure_boot;
    HVCI_CHECK             hvci;
    VBS_CHECK              vbs;
    HYPERVISOR_CHECK       hypervisor;
    KERNEL_DEBUGGING_CHECK kernel_debugging;

NLOHMANN_DEFINE_TYPE_NON_INTRUSIVE(SOURCE_RESULT, valid, value)
NLOHMANN_DEFINE_TYPE_NON_INTRUSIVE(SECURE_BOOT_CHECK, nt_query_enabled, nt_query_capable, uefi_var, registry)
NLOHMANN_DEFINE_TYPE_NON_INTRUSIVE(HVCI_CHECK, code_integrity)
NLOHMANN_DEFINE_TYPE_NON_INTRUSIVE(VBS_CHECK, nt_query_secure_kernel, nt_query_hvci)
NLOHMANN_DEFINE_TYPE_NON_INTRUSIVE(HYPERVISOR_CHECK, nt_query, cpuid)
NLOHMANN_DEFINE_TYPE_NON_INTRUSIVE(KERNEL_DEBUGGING_CHECK, nt_query_enabled, nt_query_not_present)

NLOHMANN_DEFINE_TYPE_NON_INTRUSIVE(ENVIRONMENT_REPORT,
    hwid, secure_boot, hvci, vbs, hypervisor, kernel_debugging, test_signing, tpm)
struct MODULE_REPORT {
    std::string                           hwid;
    uint64_t                              timestamp;
    BYOVD_DETECTION_REPORT                byovd;
    MANUAL_MAPPED_DRIVER_DETECTION_REPORT manual_mapped;
    FLAGGED_DLL_REPORT                    flagged_dll;
    THREAD_DETECTION_REPORT               thread;
    HASH_DIFF_REPORT                      hash_diff;
};
inline LONG json_count(const nlohmann::json& j, size_t max_entries) {
    LONG count = j.value("count", 0);
    if (count < 0) count = 0;
    if (count > (LONG)max_entries) count = (LONG)max_entries;
    return count;
}
inline void set_full_image_name(const nlohmann::json& e, WCHAR* name_buffer, size_t length, UNICODE_STRING& full_image_name) {
    const std::string name = e.value("name_buffer", std::string());
    const std::string full = e.value("full_image_name", std::string());

    sdk::string_to_wchar(name, name_buffer, length);

    const size_t full_length = full.size() < length - 1 ? full.size() : length - 1;
    full_image_name.Length        = (USHORT)(full_length * sizeof(WCHAR));
    full_image_name.MaximumLength = (USHORT)(length * sizeof(WCHAR));
    full_image_name.Buffer        = name_buffer;
}

inline void from_json(const nlohmann::json& j, BYOVD_DETECTION_REPORT& r) {
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof(r));
    r.count = json_count(j, sdk::array_count(r.entries));

    const nlohmann::json& entries = j.at("entries");
    for (LONG i = 0; i < r.count; i++) {
        const nlohmann::json& e = entries.at(i);
        BYOVD_DETECTION_ENTRY& entry = r.entries[i];

        set_full_image_name(e, entry.name_buffer, sdk::array_count(entry.name_buffer), entry.full_image_name);
        entry.device_object = (PDEVICE_OBJECT)sdk::number_to_pointer(e.value("device_object", (uint64_t)0));
        entry.driver_object = (PDRIVER_OBJECT)sdk::number_to_pointer(e.value("driver_object", (uint64_t)0));
        entry.method        = (BYOVD_DETECTION_METHOD)e.value("method", 0);
    }
}

inline void from_json(const nlohmann::json& j, MANUAL_MAPPED_DRIVER_DETECTION_REPORT& r) {
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof(r));
    r.count = json_count(j, sdk::array_count(r.entries));

    const nlohmann::json& entries = j.at("entries");
    for (LONG i = 0; i < r.count; i++) {
        const nlohmann::json& e = entries.at(i);
        MANUAL_MAPPED_DRIVER_DETECTION_ENTRY& entry = r.entries[i];

        entry.suspicious_address = sdk::number_to_pointer(e.value("suspicious_address", (uint64_t)0));
        entry.size               = (SIZE_T)e.value("size", (uint64_t)0);
        entry.method             = (DETECTION_METHOD)e.value("method", 0);

        const std::string tag = e.value("tag", std::string());
        const size_t tag_length = tag.size() < sdk::array_count(entry.tag) ? tag.size() : sdk::array_count(entry.tag);
        memcpy(entry.tag, tag.data(), tag_length);

        sdk::string_to_uchar(e.value("module_path", std::string()), entry.module_path, sdk::array_count(entry.module_path));
    }
}

inline void from_json(const nlohmann::json& j, FLAGGED_DLL_REPORT& r) {
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof(r));
    r.count = json_count(j, sdk::array_count(r.entries));

    const nlohmann::json& entries = j.at("entries");
    for (LONG i = 0; i < r.count; i++) {
        const nlohmann::json& e = entries.at(i);
        LOADED_MODULE& entry = r.entries[i];

        set_full_image_name(e, entry.name_buffer, sdk::array_count(entry.name_buffer), entry.full_image_name);
        entry.is_signed = (BOOLEAN)e.value("is_signed", 0);

        const nlohmann::json& image = e.at("mem").at("image");
        entry.mem.image.image_base = sdk::number_to_pointer(image.value("image_base", (uint64_t)0));
        entry.mem.image.image_size = (SIZE_T)image.value("image_size", (uint64_t)0);
    }
}

inline void from_json(const nlohmann::json& j, THREAD_DETECTION_REPORT& r) {
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof(r));
    r.count = json_count(j, sdk::array_count(r.entries));

    const nlohmann::json& entries = j.at("entries");
    for (LONG i = 0; i < r.count; i++) {
        const nlohmann::json& e = entries.at(i);
        CREATED_THREAD& entry = r.entries[i];

        entry.start_address       = sdk::number_to_pointer(e.value("start_address", (uint64_t)0));
        entry.is_created_remotely = (BOOLEAN)e.value("is_created_remotely", 0);
        entry.thread_id           = (HANDLE)sdk::number_to_pointer(e.value("thread_id", (uint64_t)0));
        entry.creator_id          = (HANDLE)sdk::number_to_pointer(e.value("creator_id", (uint64_t)0));
    }
}

inline void from_json(const nlohmann::json& j, HASH_DIFF_REPORT& r) {
    memset(&r, 0, sizeof(r));
    r.count = json_count(j, sdk::array_count(r.entries));

    const nlohmann::json& entries = j.at("entries");
    for (LONG i = 0; i < r.count; i++)
        r.entries[i].mismatch_type = (HASH_MISMATCH_TYPE)entries.at(i).value("mismatch_type", 0);
}

inline void from_json(const nlohmann::json& j, MODULE_REPORT& r) {
    r.hwid      = j.value("hwid", std::string());
    r.timestamp = j.value("timestamp", (uint64_t)0);

    j.at("byovd").get_to(r.byovd);
    j.at("manual_mapped").get_to(r.manual_mapped);
    j.at("flagged_dll").get_to(r.flagged_dll);
    j.at("thread").get_to(r.thread);
    j.at("hash_diff").get_to(r.hash_diff);
}
```

```h
// std::regex_match's backtracking implementation (most acutely on libstdc++)
// recurses roughly once per matched character for quantified patterns such
// as "(.*)", so a long enough path can exhaust the calling thread's stack; on
// a default ~8MB thread stack that has been observed to take on the order of
// a couple thousand characters for a simple pattern. 256 leaves a wide safety
// margin below that (well under the 8192-byte request URI limit) while still
// fitting any realistic route segment; raise it if a route legitimately needs
// longer paths. Regex routes are never applied to paths longer than this.
#ifndef CPPHTTPLIB_REGEX_ROUTE_PATH_MAX_LENGTH
#define CPPHTTPLIB_REGEX_ROUTE_PATH_MAX_LENGTH 256
#endif

#define CPPHTTPLIB_SEND_BUFSIZ size_t(16384u)
#endif

#ifndef CPPHTTPLIB_COMPRESSION_BUFSIZ
#define CPPHTTPLIB_COMPRESSION_BUFSIZ size_t(16384u)

#define CPPHTTPLIB_THREAD_POOL_COUNT                                           \
  ((std::max)(8u, std::thread::hardware_concurrency() > 0                      \
                      ? std::thread::hardware_concurrency() - 1                \
                      : 0))
#endif
```
